name: Don't Blink
storyline:
You are trapped inside an abandoned asylum as the latest experiment of a mad scientist - Dr. Otto Reikmann.

He has implanted you with a neurological device that injects chemicals into your brain every time you blink causing hallucinations and slowly driving you into madness.

Dr. Reikmann watches your descent through surveillance cameras, constantly taunting you over the PA system.

When you attempt to escape, he dispatches his wicked assistant to hunt you down and capture you.

Throughout the asylum you find previous victims that have already gone mad and left notes with survival strategies. Follow the notes and you will make it out alive.

Every blink triggers dynamic events throughout the asylum. Some of them are helpful while others are terrifying.

If the player refuses to blink his vision begins to blur and split, simulating the physical strain of forcing the eyes to stay open.

With each blink, the neurological device pushes the player closer to madness.

The game’s main antagonist is the Doctor’s Assistant.

Once human, he is now a disfigured result of the doctor’s failed experiments.

Though blind, he sees everything through the asylum’s surveillance camera system.

To evade him, the player must disable the camera in each room before being detected.

Once his sight is cut off, survival depends on silence - player must move carefully or distract him by throwing objects, as his hearing is exceptionally sharp.

He moves closer to the player every time player blinks.
summary: First-person psychological horror game. Navigate an abandoned asylum where blinking reshapes your surroundings - sometimes helping you, sometimes unleashing terror. The game blends slow-burn tension, stealth and psychological horror.
